description: Current LLMs, including Claude, appear to be ASL-2.

instances.assertion: Current LLMs, including Claude, appear to be ASL-2.

Current LLMs, including state-of-the-art models, exhibit measurable situational awareness, such as recognizing their own generated text and distinguishing between evaluation and deployment environments.
